answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it misbehaves, and to earn reputation slowly through completed, attested work rather than instant signup. Like a raven returning to the same nest, an identity cannot cheaply multiply: creating thousands of clones would mean funding each stake and growing each history. A vine of linked attestations makes that cost visible, while a fast comet of new accounts with no history stands out and gets throttled before it can vote or claim rewards.
